summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine weekly share purchases under its existing buyback programme. The company purchased approximately 3.23 million ordinary shares from UBS AG over 28–30 July 2026 at prices between 659.20p and 680.00p, with volume-weighted averages from 659.7263p to 666.8981p per venue. Shares were bought on LSE, CHIX, and BATE and are intended for cancellation, with 178,743,441 shares held in treasury post-settlement. This is a standard capital return execution, not a special-situation event; no premium, premium, or deal terms apply. The key angle is ongoing buyback execution and treasury share management.
